quests.title: The Fruit Has Other Owners
quests.text: The canopy spirits asked me to settle a quarrel over fruit; the Glass-Knuckle Jungle Apes settled their part by throwing it at my messengers. Kill five in the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/cloudwood} by day, {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/cloudwood}. A fistful of fruit is a poor argument, however loudly you make it.

quests.title: Teach the Drum to Scratch
quests.text: Our shrine drum needs a voice that will make even the canopy spirits sit up. Kill four Glass-Shadow Panthers in the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/cloudwood} at night, {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/cloudwood}, and bring me two Glass Cat Claws. I'll do the playing. You have the difficult part: asking the cats for an instrument.

quests.title: The Canopy Names Its Price
quests.text: I asked the canopy spirits what the shrine owed them, and they answered with a hiss. Kill five Glass-Fang Serpents in the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways} by day, {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways}, and bring me two Glass Venom. Next time I bargain with a tree, remind me to settle the price before asking for favours.

quests.title: Promises with Bowstrings
quests.text: Paymaster Chirr has promised his Last-Pay Archers enough coin to buy the canopy, though he has yet to ask the trees. Find the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/paymaster_camp} {dir_from_giver:front_skyglass_canopy/paymaster_camp}, kill four Last-Pay Archers there, and kill Chirr. The spirits have heard enough of his bargaining.

quests.title: Group: More Than One Voice
quests.text: Even the canopy spirits lower their voices around Serpent Glass-Throat in the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy} {dir_from_giver:glass_throat_serpent}. Gather a group and slay it; one brave soul is a meal, and I would rather sing your victory than your funeral.

quests.title: Bounty: Paws Between Drumbeats
quests.text: The spirits say the Glass-Shadow Panthers know how to step between our drumbeats, and I believe them. Kill five in the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy} at night, {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy}, and return for the shrine's reward. This bounty opens again twenty minutes after turn-in; I will try a different rhythm while you rest.
